bugs.what: Strongbox lock requires 12+ roll, failed on 3, warned it jams permanently — too punishing for optional content; no clear reward path for opening it
Crown path referenced (elder's coffer, proof of grief, verses+crown=deeper rest) but appears unimplemented — no way to access elder or retrieve crown as alternative ending
Seal/open barrow choice at throne felt arbitrary without prior conversation with reeve or priest — player doesn't know what each path means until after choosing

confusions: Crown path mentioned in intro and notice board but no way to pursue it to completion
'Proof of grief' (needed for crown) — unclear if hearing king's monologue counts or if physical token required
Optional side paths (*) — purpose unclear, no guidance on what's worth exploring
'Deeper rest' ending (verses + crown) described in intro but no path to reach it
suggestions: Implement crown path fully: make elder's coffer accessible, clarify proof-of-grief mechanics, create verses+crown ending
Either make strongbox openable (lower DC or add tool) or remove it; dead-end optional content is confusing
Add scene where player meets reeve and priest before throne — let them explain barrow choice consequences
Guide verses-only player toward 'why not try the crown path too' if both paths are intended to be viable
